floorPlans.introduction: Explore Kaia’s Vina, Ava and Luna three and four bedroom layouts. These complete Kaia-branded sheets come from a broker-hosted Emaar booklet. Published built-up area includes suite, garage and balcony or terrace components; it is not the plot area.
floorPlans.note: The official Kaia download currently opens an Elea-branded booklet; it is excluded here. The Kaia-branded mirror is provided with its source and original notices. Published areas and component tables can contain rounding or transcription differences; confirm the selected unit and final sale plan.
